runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and competitors derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Price **$4.72** (close 2026-10-28, aggregator, flagged) x **84,677,075 shares** (10-Q cover of 2026-08-11, accession 0001437749-26-027664; 84,161,245 issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, no treasury, the difference read as the August 2026 Lytton draw fee shares and vesting units) = cap **$399.7M**; about 11.4M further shares possible from options, units, convertibles, preferred and warrants; sovereign **5.37%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-28). **Q1 OUT**: the deciding part, read by a CONVENTION of the run (segment assets and what the price pays for, because a five-year operating loss leaves no positive total for the more-than-half test), is Land and Water Resources, the Mojave Groundwater Bank: FY2025 revenue $1.8M, operating loss $(28.1)M, assets $130.9M, "pre-revenue" in the filer's words; ATEC filtration $14.5M revenue, $2.5M operating income, does not decide. Key variables not foreseeable: Air Force and California State Lands Commission approvals still to come for the Northern Pipeline (BLM right-of-way effective 2026-07-14), a Metropolitan agreement for the Southern Pipeline (Metropolitan's board refused the 2002 project "By a very narrow margin", 10-K FY2016); build cost $1.25 to $1.5 billion, up from about $800M, with $51M of about $451M of equity committed and $400M in due diligence; the common's share of MWI not set in any filing, Lytton able to convert into 51% of storage cash flows; the filer "cannot predict with certainty when, if ever" revenue will cover costs. Closed OUT on the start-up rows, the alternative reading TOO HARD (NATURE) closing the file alike. Q2 to Q12 NOT REACHED; the 10-K names no competitor for either segment, none chosen. Balance sheet: equity negative 2016 to 2020, $4.7M at 2026-06-30, accumulated deficit $712.2M against $716.0M paid in; cash never above $17.3M at a year-end, $5.3M at 2026-06-30; debt $87.0M plus a $29.4M related-party lease obligation accreting interest, effective rate 15.4%; Heerema secured loans due 2027-06-30, Heerema also the 30.5% holder; shares 13.7M (2010) to 84.7M, equity sold in ten of twelve years 2014 to 2025; $57.5M 8.875% cumulative preferred. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash negative every year FY2021 to FY2025, mean -$29.6M before interest after all spending, -$21.4M after maintenance (depreciation as the guess); no-growth case alone under (b); net debt $111.1M; value range all-equity, central, **-$6.03 to -$7.82 a share**; equity-only -$5.19 to -$6.99; fair price all-equity -$4.33, equity-only -$3.27, -$5.00 with the preferred deducted as a CONVENTION of the run; not positive. Facts after the stop, not weighed: pay tied to permits and financings; the FY2016 10-K's 2017 contract forecast not met; PwC clean opinion. Could not get: the related party behind the lease obligation; the 2026-05-20 shareholder letter beyond its cover; the Air Force and CSLC status after the 10-K beyond the 10-Q; the FY2017 to FY2020 10-Ks. Framework gaps for the operator: "start-up" undefined for a pre-revenue project inside an old company (OUT against TOO HARD (NATURE) would differ for any re-run); the business-of-parts threshold when five-year operating profit is negative; Q7 when owner cash is negative every year (a negative top of range reported as a figure); preferred stock not named in net debt. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 28 ids in the ledger, 20 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: one file-name search of the `Test Runs/` listing for the name before any fetch (nothing returned), the session's commit subjects and git status, memory index lines; none used. The run file's framework section refers to the operator with a gendered pronoun; recorded, not edited. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1: the Mojave Desert water project inside a forty-year-old company is a start-up in substance, no water sold, permits from the Air Force, the State Lands Commission and Metropolitan still to come, a $1.25 to $1.5 billion build mostly unfinanced and the common's share of MWI undefined; owner cash negative every year; computation only, all-equity value range -$6.03 to -$7.82 against $4.72. Not armed.
